QuestionStmt.S: Which from following functional groups has highest priority order for naming the polyfunctional group compounds?

Solution.S:
In IUPAC nomenclature, the priority order of functional groups is:

-COOH > -SO₃H > -COOR > -COCl > -CONH₂ > -CN > -CHO > >C=O > -OH > -NH₂ > -C≡C- > -C=C-

Among the given options, -SO₃H (sulphonic acid) has the highest priority.

Thus, the correct option is B: -SO₃H.
